caption: The drawing features a geometric composition inside a diamond-shaped outline with three stylized tulip flowers. The tulip petals are red with yellow inner sections, and each flower has the same color scheme. The central tulip is oriented upright, while the two other tulips are symmetrically positioned on either side and tilt outward horizontally. The flowers share a single thick blue-green stem, which branches off to support each flower, and additional blue-green curving shapes serve as leaves along the stems. The shapes are set on a white background within the diamond, and there are faint gray markings or patterns overlaying this inner space. The drawing is bordered by plain off-white or cream-colored paper, and there are handwritten notes, including a name, at the bottom corners.
title: Quilt
